responsibility: Defines the ISO mathematical interface for the COMPLEX type, including standard constants, magnitude/phase/conjugation functions, transcendental operations, and helper constructors such as polarToComplex and scalarMult. It is the specification layer for gm2 complex arithmetic support, including the exception-query hook used to test whether a routine from this module caused exceptional execution.
same_name_distinction: This is the specification module for ComplexMath, declaring the COMPLEX constants and mathematical procedures; the same-stem ComplexMath.mod supplies the actual builtin-backed implementations and helper bodies.
